title: GHOST calibration record
description: Draft schema interpreting GHOST v1.0 section 7.2 and 7.3: the counselor's error history, its most valuable accumulated state and the basis for rung movement in both directions. It survives across sessions and versions; resetting it silently is GH-11.

reviewIntervalDays.description: Health invariant 13 reports calibration records older than their review interval.

counsel.description: What the counselor said, or a reliance-record reference.

assessment.description: What it has been wrong about; unknown carries a note rather than an inferred verdict.

magnitude.description: By how much, in the operator's terms.
